basic_info.description: Sun-drenched, West facing 1 bedroom condo nestled in the heart of San Francisco. This stylish 699-square-foot residence offers a seamless blend of comfort and sophistication, perfect for those seeking a vibrant urban lifestyle with motorized window shades in both living and bed room.Walk-in closet and a patio completes the bedroom.Luxurious kitchen boasts Bosch all stainless gas appliances and Studio Becker cabinetry, catering to your culinary adventures.Spa-like bathroom features Sidler Diamando Mirrored Cabinet and frameless shower glass door.Electrolux stackable washer and dryer are located in-unit.Extra wide deeded parking space accommodates larger car.Begin your mornings with a breathtaking view from the common roof deck, or unwind in the peaceful common outdoor space. The building offers the convenience of a concierge and doorman service, ensuring a seamless living experience. For those who love to grill, the barbecue area awaits your culinary creations.Discover the best of San Francisco living with Haraz Coffee House onsite, and where major tech shuttles are practically at your door stop.Whole Foods, multiple cafes/restaurants, as well as UPS & Fedex all conveniently located nearby.With a WalkScore of 99, it's a walker's paradise!
